description: This file defines the StandardDeviation class in the org.apache.commons.math3.stat.descriptive.moment package. It computes the sample or population standard deviation by wrapping a Variance class instance and provides methods for incremental calculation, evaluation of an array of data, copying, and configuration of bias correction.

classes.name: StandardDeviation
classes.description: A class for computing the standard deviation (either sample or population) of a dataset, supporting incremental updates, array evaluations, and configuration of bias correction.
